verdict.rationale: Mercury documents first-party in-product AI that works on the user's own data: AI reads bills, auto-populates payment details and remembers past recipients, and AI-powered automations help close the books. These are automation and pre-fill features rather than insights or suggestions, so the analytical half of the story is unevidenced. The MCP server and the official spend-analysis and anomaly-detection skills run in external AI agents via the CLI, not inside Mercury, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: an in-product AI insights or analysis surface (spend trends, anomalies, recommendations), documented proactive suggestions inside the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients — so you can approve and pay in seconds.
